The consumers have positive finite scale, center/bottom justification, unit extrusion, source-consistent vertices, directions and miters, two segment parameters per element, zero second values, absent group 42 and zero area-fill counts.

Unique ByLayer and Continuous LTYPE providers are checked. Both consumers retain their source style identity and group-340 reference, emit group 73 = 15 and exact group-74/group-41/group-75 arrays, and pass fresh-import checks in model space and a named block.
contract.failureAndRetry: Unsupported style-flag and late live-consumer mutation controls each refuse before publication and preserve destination/caller contracts. Corrected state retries successfully on the same adapter for both ASCII and binary outputs.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. The AC1027 fixture is created at runtime and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: The new evidence qualifies only source count 14 to target count 15 under the generated tuple pattern and selected consumer geometry. Other counts, append batches, removals, MLINE schemas/carriers/versions, native rendering and whole-document closure remain separate. No support claim is promoted.
